pass_a_gloss: He-lies-in-wait in secret, as lion in the fold of-him; he-lies-in-wait of-the to-seize poor, to-seize poor in the to-draw him in the snare of-him; he-will-humble him, he-will-stoop, and he-will-fall in the him to-dominate of-the poor. Just-as the lion here-and-there transfers the eye, prey seeking, thus by-night and with day of-seizure and greed he-devises a-device; but nevertheless he-will-stoop, and he-will-fall. He-draws on-the-one-hand through the reasoning, he-seizes and through the according-to-act sin.
pass_b_english: “He lies in wait in secret, as a lion in his fold; he lies in wait to seize the poor, to seize the poor in drawing him in his snare; he will humble him, he will stoop, and he will fall in his dominating the poor” (Psalm 9:30-32).

Just as the lion transfers the eye here and there, seeking prey, so night and day he devises a device of seizure and greed; but nevertheless he will stoop, and he will fall. He draws through reasoning, but seizes through sin in act.

choices.english: he will stoop, and he will fall
choices.why: The hunter’s own stoop is his fall. Not ‘he will bow in worship’.
